newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 12 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 50 billion dong ($4.29 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 12.0 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on April 2, the central bank issued one billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 12.0 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is May 9 and maturity will be on May 9, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of Vietnam 36.4 billion
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam 2.2 billion
Vietnam General Insurance Corporation (Bao Viet) 9.0 billion
